name: com.bit34games.makerpanels
displayName: Bit34 MakerPanels - Level editor UI parts
description: The UI parts an in-game level editor is built from: a panel of labelled fields, and a list of things to pick from. Both are Unity views a consumer subclasses, and neither knows what it is editing. A panel is a field list rather than owning one, so anything beside its fields goes into the list as a field — a button is a field, a dropdown is a field.
